name: test-fix-harness
description: Distributed test-fix harness. Fans a dashboard of failing/flaky/skipping tests across on-demand dev host workers running headless Claude Code, coordinated by a master-owned SQLite queue over SSH. Two-phase pipeline: diagnose each test (debug skill) -> dedup root causes -> fix one per cause. Nothing auto-lands (workers stop at a published diff). GPU/RE lease scheduler with per-test routing. Commands: /fix-my-tests (run the pipeline), /fix-my-tests:status (dashboard).
